evidence: Labeled RPC/REST/ZMQ and modifies src/httpserver.cpp, src/bitcoin-cli.cpp, and RPC connection options.
rationale: Implements UNIX domain socket support for the HTTP RPC server and bitcoin-cli, resolving issue #5029 dating back to 2014. Allowing local RPC access via filesystem permissions rather than TCP loopback with -rpcallowip addresses a longstanding integration pain point for external tools relying on Core.
